Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG game sprite, cut out with true alpha, for the approved prison-factory concept in reference image 1. Reference image is style and object-design source. MATCH its hand-painted orthographic overhead 2D game art with slightly visible front faces, desaturated cream/steel blue/rust, fine weathering, soft upper-left light, crisp readable contours at game scale. Absolutely no isometric tilt, no front-elevation view, no perspective photography. One isolated asset with generous transparent margin. Preserve the exact design language from the concept, not a new redesign. No text, captions, people, floor background, surrounding room or checkerboard. Genuine transparent background, no white matte, no built-in broad ground shadow.
Subject: the LONG silver cylindrical pressure vessel standing in the WEST vertical wing of the L-shaped equipment room in reference. Its long horizontal cylinder axis lies NORTH-SOUTH in the map, so the sprite is tall and narrow (about 1:2.8 width:height), viewed from above. Rounded domed end at bottom with circular end plate and a centered dark flange, long satin galvanized steel shell with a central seam, 3 reinforcement bands, rivets, subtle rust speckles and a tiny inspection hatch on upper curved surface. Two dark steel supporting saddles rest below it near ends, visible from above. No vertical upright storage tower, no wheels, no large attached red/blue pipelines; pipelines will be separate sprites. Output portrait tall sprite matching the concept tank.

One low eight-sided worn grey concrete plinth with cream chamfered coping, front-facing 3 shallow steps at SOUTH/bottom edge. Central low round dark steel valve chamber has a large red handwheel on top and a short red pipe connection extending NORTH toward rear rail, no tall tower. Faded yellow-black hazard bands around its small circular base. A blue industrial safety rail runs ONLY along the REAR/NORTH and diagonal rear sides of the octagon; front half is completely open, no closed circle fence. One black rectangular grated inspection cover on the left surface, 2 small restrained blue drums near left/right rear. No greenery or surrounding floor/road, just octagonal platform and attached elements. Strict overhead like reference; sprite width:height around 1.15:1. Distinct eight-sided footprint, readable step and rail silhouette, not a rectangular slab.

Subject: ONE modular overhead PIPE GANTRY BAY for the long horizontal gantry in approved concept. Overall sprite very wide landscape roughly 3.3:1 width:height. Along the top runs a straight horizontal pair of industrial pipes, rusty RED pipe above and dark BLUE pipe below, same length, each with joining flanges and 2 simple collar clamps. Pipe ends at LEFT and RIGHT are straight flush butt joints, NO elbows, NO caps, NO vertical drop at ends, so identical bays connect seamlessly. At the CENTER only, a slender dark steel post/support descends from beam toward bottom of image, showing bolted X-braced frame and a small concrete/steel base foot. The red and blue tubes are high above the post foot, with EMPTY TRANSPARENT space underneath them on both sides of center post; characters must be able to walk beneath the tubes. No second or edge post. The rendered beam thickness is about 12% of sprite total height; post provides the rest. Matching rust, steel framework and pipe proportions from concept. No floor slab, no background, no extra machinery. Output one correctly overhead-view horizontal bay, not side-elevation civil engineering diagram.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG cutout sprites for the approved pipe-energy courtyard. Input image 1 is the exact style/design reference. Hand-painted orthographic overhead 2D game sprite with slight visible near/front faces, weathered steel, warm cream stone, desaturated red/blue, upper-left lighting. Create a production atlas of SIX isolated industrial pipe fitting sprites, arranged on a regular 3-column by 2-row grid with wide fully transparent gutters. All pipe widths consistent with the reference gantry. Top left: horizontal parallel red-above/blue-below straight pipes, flush straight ends, no supports. Top middle: parallel red/blue two-pipe 90-degree elbow, connections on LEFT and TOP, as the warehouse end bend in reference. Top right: parallel red/blue two-pipe 90-degree elbow, connections on TOP and RIGHT (used inside L-building). Bottom left: single rusty RED straight pipe oriented VERTICAL with one flange around the middle, straight flush ends. Bottom middle: single dark BLUE straight pipe oriented VERTICAL, two flange bands, straight flush ends. Bottom right: RED T-junction with LEFT and RIGHT horizontal connection and a SOUTH/bottom branch, matching the outdoor platform feeder. Strictly viewed from above, not diagonal isometric. Center each sprite in its cell. No captions or cell lines. Pipes must have hollow/metal visible butt connection ends, not bulbous decorative ornaments. Each fitting is an independent reusable component.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE opaque seamless square terrain texture for the approved prison-factory pipe-energy courtyard. Reference image 1 provides the material style. Strictly flat top-down worn warm grey concrete paving from the open courtyard, subtle brown/grayed olive aging, thin faint slab joints in a 2-by-2 grid of LARGE square slabs across the texture, gentle hairline cracks and sparse tiny dirt marks. No plants, pipes, grass, objects, hazard stripes, stone edges, strong shadows or perspective; material texture ONLY. Grid lines stay subtle. Fine hand-painted 2D game texture, no photoreal harsh contrast.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent game prop for an existing 2D prison industrial courtyard. Create ONLY the isolated small maintenance-parts canopy visible at lower right in the reference courtyard (reference is inspiration only; do not reproduce the scene). Orthographic top-down 3/4 game camera looking from south, all vertical lines vertical on screen, horizontal footprint axis aligned, NO diamond isometric. Old olive green square tarpaulin roof with X seams, sagged weathered canvas, four slender dark steel posts, a few spare crates tucked underneath on a wooden base. Roof occupies upper two-thirds, two front post feet clearly visible below. Painted realistic sprite, crisp dark outlines, muted olive/gray palette, fine worn edges, upper-left light, restrained baked contact shadow. Match prison sprites, small utilitarian canopy not festive tent. Entire object centered with 8 percent padding on genuine transparent RGBA background. No surrounding floor, no people, no labels, no foliage, no extra objects. Single prop only.
